test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

She asked me why I was not eating.

options.text: She said, “Why is he not eating?”
She said, “Why are you not eating?”
She said, “Why am I not eating?”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She asked me why I was not eating.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"why I was not eating" becomes "Why are you not eating?"**
 
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "you" to match direct speech.
 
• Verb "was" is changed to "are" to match present tense in direct questions.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Why" and ends with a question mark "?".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"“Why are you not eating?” she said."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "She said, “Why is he not eating?”" 

 
 
• Pronoun "he" is incorrect; it should be "you" to match the direct speech conversion.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** “She said, “Why am I not eating?”" 
 
 
• Pronoun "I" is incorrect; it should be "you" to match the direct speech conversion.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "She said, “Why don’t you eat?”" 
 
 
• Sentence structure changes the context and meaning.
